paite: Luita tui duh a nak hawkhawk sakhi bang in, Pathian aw, ka hinna nangmah duh in anak hawkhawk hi.
heading: Korah Tate La / BU NIHNA / (Sam 42-72) / Saltangmi Thumna;
english: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.

paite: Ka hinna Pathian duh in, Pathian hing duh in, adangtak ahi; chikchiang in ahia Pathian ma ka tun ding a, amai ka muh ding.
english: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?

paite: Ka khitui sun leh zan in ka an ahi a, na Pathian koi a om ahia le! hon chi nilouh ua.
english: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

paite: Hiai thil ka theigige a, ka hinna ka sung ah ka sungbua a, mipi lak a ka pai in, nopna leh phatna ging toh, mi tampi ankuangluina a Pathian inn zuan a ama uh ka kaih zeldante.
english: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.

paite: Ka hinna aw, bang achia kun nilouh? Bang achia ka sung a buai? Pathian lamen in; amel a damna ziak in amah ka hon phat ding ahi ngal a, hon panpihpa leh ka Pathian.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

paite: Ka Pathian aw, ka hinna ka sung ah akun nilouh; huaiziak in Jordan leh Hermon gam a kipan, Mizar tang a kipan in ka hon theigige ahi.
english: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.

paite: Na tui luang ging zuazuate ah tui thuk leh tui thuk akisam ua; na tuikihot leh na tui kisep teng in hon vuktumta hi.
english: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.

paite: Himahleh, TOUPA'N azahngaihna sun in thu ape ding a, ala in zan chiang in hon ompih ding hi, ka hinna Pathian kiang a thumna in.
english: Yahweh will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.

paite: Pathian ka suangpi kiang ah, "Bangziak a hon mangngilh a bang ding a melma nuaisiahna ziak a lungkham a ka mau vialvial nak!" ka chi ding hi.
english: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”

paite: Ka guh a namsau om bang mai in hon doute'n hon gense gige ua; Na Pathian koi a om ahia le! Hon chi nilouh ua.
english: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

paite: Ka hinna aw, bang achia kun nilouh? Bang achia ka sung a buai? Pathian lamen in; amah ka phat ding a, hon panpihpa leh ka Pathian ahi.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.
